title: ReHued Carbon
description: Vanilla textures, regraded with a cohesive blue-purple tone for a cleaner, more polished look.
body:
# ReHued Carbon

ReHued Carbon is a vanilla-friendly resource pack that refines the color palette of diamond-related textures using a consistent blue–purple grading.

![ReHued Carbon vs. Vanilla: Blocks & Armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cbfdea85ffa6359dd45f58b7548cce6ca6e014b0.png)

Instead of redesigning textures, this pack focuses on subtle, systematic adjustments to hue and saturation. The result is a cleaner, more cohesive look that feels natural within Minecraft’s original style.

## Give your feedback/experience at:
- FlossyFish63943 [Discord]
OR
- aaronabrm@gmail.com [EMail]

## Features

- Consistent blue–purple color grading
- Preserves original shading and texture detail
- Works across diamond tools, armor, and related items
- Balanced to avoid over-saturation or visual noise
- Lightweight and compatible with other vanilla-style packs

## Approach

This pack was created using a custom color processing workflow that:
- Adjusts hue while preserving brightness (value)
- Applies weighted changes based on saturation
- Protects dark outlines and bright highlights
- Minimizes distortion of non-target materials (like wood)

The goal is not to replace Minecraft’s art style, but to refine it.

## Variants

Part of the **ReHued** series:

- **ReHued Carbon** – Diamond
- **ReHued Aurum** – Gold (planned)
- **ReHued Cuprum** – Copper (planned)
- **ReHued+** – Combined pack (planned)

## Philosophy

> Not a redesign. A refinement.

## Installation

1. Download the pack
2. Place it in your `.minecraft/resourcepacks` folder
3. Enable it in-game
